examples.arabic: هو كتب الدرس على السبورة البيضاء
examples.english: He wrote the lesson on the white board.
examples.transliteration: Huwa kataba al-dars ala al-sabboura al-baydaa

examples.arabic: الأم تبتسم وتقول ابني كتب الدرس جيدا
examples.english: The mother smiles and says: My son wrote the lesson well.
examples.transliteration: Al-umm tabtasim wa taqool ibni kataba al-dars jayyidan.

examples.english: They say "And peace be upon you too" and we begin the lesson.
examples.transliteration: Yaquluna Wa alaykum as-salam wa nabda'u ad-dars.

examples.arabic: كان الدرس الاول في الصف صعبا قليلا لكن سارة حاولت الفهم
examples.english: The first lesson in class was a little difficult but Sarah tried to understand
examples.transliteration: Kāna ad-darsu al-awwalu fī aṣ-ṣaffi ṣa'ban qaleelan lākinna Sārata ḥāwalati al-fahma
